root_cause: Code added in one commit used an undeclared identifier and chained a non-Promise builder with .catch; both only fail on specific paths, so the bundle stayed green.

actual_sources: deno check on supabase/functions/* at main cf5bbb2: TS2304 Cannot find name 'uuid' (powerhouse-runtime); TS2551 'catch' on PostgrestFilterBuilder (two functions)

fix: Declared uuid at module top; replaced .catch on builders with .then(ok, err).
prevention_rule: Edge functions must pass deno check for runtime-relevant errors (undeclared names, non-existent methods) before merge.
terminal_rule: Not terminal until the remaining type-only errors are triaged in a follow-up.
